payload.leagueSummary: NET is the whole damn battlefield right now, and the top of this rolling window is a tight little scrum where a couple guys are separating with complete tee-to-green packages while the rest are either surviving on putter heat or getting dragged around by one ugly category. leagueBullets: Ntownsend72 is the cleanest profile in the window: wins on both boards, elite tee-to-green, and basically no boogeyman showing up in the stat line yet.
